name: Auto-Generate Campaign Analytics
description: When a campaign is marked as COMPLETE, automatically generate a campaign analytics report with reach, engagement, watch time, and attribution data. Send the report to the admin and prepare a client-facing summary.

then.prompt: A campaign was just marked as complete. Generate a full campaign analytics report including: total reach across all creators, average engagement rate, total watch time, click-through rates, promo code redemptions, and estimated ROI. Format this as both an internal report (for the admin dashboard) and a client-facing summary (for email delivery). Include comparison to industry benchmarks where possible.
